firstPlayerRule: With three or four players, whoever visited Japan most recently is the first month's starting player; choose randomly if nobody has visited Japan. With two players, randomly assign the Sun and Moon tokens; the Sun player starts the first month.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The starter chooses an Ikizama space first. The chosen spaces then determine the action order, so the setup starter does not necessarily take the first action.
For the first month's choice order, the starting player's firefighting marker is on top of the stack, with the other markers underneath in clockwise order.
